(* A necessary continuity screen, not a complete analyticity proof.
   Refuse rather than silently substitute an endpoint value for a different
   punctured-neighborhood limit. Both sides are checked deliberately: this
   conservative patch does not introduce a new one-sided observable contract. *)
seriesObservableEndpointContinuousQ[head_, center_, ass_] := Module[
  {v = Unique["observableContinuity$"], value, limits},
  value = head[center];
  limits = TimeConstrained[Quiet[{
    Limit[head[center + v], v -> 0, Direction -> -1, Assumptions -> ass],
    Limit[head[center - v], v -> 0, Direction -> -1, Assumptions -> ass]}], 2, $Failed];
  ListQ[limits] && Length[limits] === 2 &&
    And @@ (TrueQ[Simplify[# == value, ass]] & /@ limits)];
